description:
Torque Sensor Smoothness & Silent Belt Drive
Experience a natural and intuitive ride powered by the premium torque sensor system. Unlike standard cadence sensors, the BK18 Pro's torque sensor measures your actual pedaling force, delivering instant, incredibly smooth, and quiet assistance right when you need it. Paired with a powerful, low-maintenance rear hub brushless motor and an advanced belt drive system, you get a whisper-quiet journey that feels more like an upscale traditional bike. Choose from 5 levels of Pedal Assist (PAS) to perfectly match your effort and terrain.
Elegant Integrated Design & Extended Range
The BK18 Pro features an aesthetically pleasing design with a seamlessly integrated, removable 36V 10.4Ah (374.4Wh) battery. This clever in-frame placement not only provides a clean, elegant look but also secures the battery safely. Enjoy the freedom of a long-range commute or weekend adventure, offering an impressive assisted range of 40-80 km (25-50 miles) on a single charge. Charge it conveniently on or off the bike.
Safety is paramount. The BK18 Pro comes equipped with newly upgraded and highly reliable front and rear hydraulic disc brakes. These premium brakes provide exceptional stopping power in all weather conditions, requiring less hand effort and offering precise modulation for superior control and peace of mind on busy city streets. Ride confidently knowing you have ample stopping force when you need it most.
Low-Step Frame Comfort & Lightweight Agility
Designed for maximum accessibility and comfort, the BK18 Pro features a high-strength, lightweight aluminum alloy step-through frame. This low-step design is a crucial feature, allowing riders of all heights and mobilities to easily mount and dismount, making it perfect for daily errands and city commuting. Weighing in at only 20 kg (44 lbs), it’s exceptionally agile and easy to maneuver or carry. The adjustable handlebar angle, puncture-resistant 700*42c road tires, and included fenders/lights complete the thoughtful design for an all-weather, comfortable ride.
Enter the age of smart riding with the dedicated HITWAY Mobile APP functionality. Connect your BK18 Pro to your smartphone to unlock advanced features, including tracking your ride mileage and history, remotely locking/unlocking your e-bike for enhanced security, and performing smart fault detection for easy maintenance checks. Keep your e-bike running smoothly and securely, all from the palm of your hand.
